items.title: Moderna (MRNA) Starts Phase 1 Canada Trial For Bundibugyo Ebola mRNA Vaccine
items.summary: Moderna (NasdaqGS:MRNA) has initiated a Phase 1 clinical trial in Canada for its investigational mRNA vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The program addresses a strain of Ebola that currently has no approved vaccine and is positioned as part of Moderna's broader infectious disease portfolio.
